set.name: Reckoning
set.theme: The Ruination / Black Mist storyline (Ruined King event). Origins include Forgotten, Hellion, Dawnbringer, Nightbringer, Redeemed, Revenant, Abomination, Coven, Dragonslayer, Draconic, Ironclad, Verdant, Eternal, God-King.

notes.itemScope: Items come from the patch 11.14 CDragon file, filtered to apiName prefixes TFT_Item_,TFT5_Item_, with recipe-less legacy TFT_Item_ entries dropped and entries containing Radiant excluded.
notes.abilityValues: Computed with 100 AP and no items; star order 1/2/3. Unresolved placeholders listed per ability.
notes.augmentTiers: Inferred from icon art suffix or apiName; approximate.

mechanics: Shadow Items: Shadow components appear on every carousel after the first and in the Armory. One Shadow component plus any component builds a Shadow item: stronger than the base item with a drawback (for example Sacrificial Infinity Edge damages the holder on crit). [11.9 notes]
Carousels in Set 5 contained 2 Shadow items 70%, 3 25%, 4 5%. [wiki Carousel]
The Armory debuted: a pop-up free pick of one item from a few options. [11.9 notes]
Hyper Roll launched as TFT's first Lab mode. [11.9 notes]
systemChanges: Mana from damage taken: 6% pre-mitigation changed to 1% pre-mitigation + 7% post-mitigation. [11.9 notes]
Units re-evaluate chase: move 1 hex only if that puts the target in range, else retarget. Assassins always jump first. [11.9 notes]
Conventions: range measured in hexes, Spell Power renamed Ability Power, all physical damage can crit and be dodged. Shop cards of units you own glow. [11.9 notes]
Component stat deflation: BF Sword 15 to 10 AD, Bow 15% to 10% AS, Rod 15 to 10 AP, Vest 25 to 20, Cloak 25 to 20, Belt 200 to 150 HP, Gloves 10% to 5% crit. [11.9 notes]
New tiebreaker: "won a round more recently". Shorter carousel and early-round timers. [11.9 notes]

ability.name: Teemo's Cruelty

ability.name: Sovereign's Domination
ability.description: Viego corrupts the soul of his target for 5 seconds, stunning them and dealing 180/300/1500 magic damage, increasing 100% each second. Viego will be interrupted if he is stunned, and Viego's allies prefer not to target his victim during soul corruption. If his victim dies, they are resurrected at full Health to fight for him, but they lose 15/7/0% of their maximum Health per second. Resurrected enemies receive the Trait bonuses of Viego's team instead of their own.

If his victim dies, they are resurrected at full Health to fight for him, but they lose @DecayPercentDamagePerSecond@% of their maximum Health per second. Resurrected enemies receive the Trait bonuses of Viego's team instead of their own.
